newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nerefco workers accept lay-off scheme.
newsitem.headline: Nerefco workers accept lay-off scheme.

text.p: Workers at the two refineries of Nerefco, a BP /Texaco joint venture, have accepted the company's lay-off scheme, ending the possibility of strike action, Nerefco said on Friday.
"The (union) members agreed to Nerefco's social plan on Thursday....This accord marks the end of the protacted negotiations," the company said in a statement.
Two weeks ago, workers rejected the company's sacial plan proposals and staged a brief wildcat strike at Nerefco's Pernis refinery in Rotterdam.
On Saturday, the company and the two unions, the FNV and the CNV, reached a provisional agreement on a revised document which the unions then recommended to members.

Pernis is due to close in 1999. Nerefco will increase production at its other Dutch refinery at Europoort, at a cost of 350 million guilders ($204 million), but will still lay off 350 of its 875 employees.
